Who gets new enquiries

Read each line as a sentence. The top one is checked first; if it does not fit, the next is tried. The result is a suggestion for manager approval, not an automatic hand-off.

Who gets which budget

Send leads in a budget range to one employee. They show up as that person's suggestion in Manager approval. Only new leads are affected; leads already here stay as they are.
